risks.title: Global economic uncertainty and market volatility
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned first in the 'Risks Related to Our Business' section (page 12). The language used ('could adversely affect', 'could continue to have an adverse effect') indicates significant concern. The current economic context justifies a high severity rating.

risks.title: Intense competitive pressure and loss of major customers
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed across several paragraphs (pages 12-13) with strong language ('intense competition', 'unable to compete effectively', 'loss of, or a failure by, one of HBP's or CPP's significant customers could adversely impact'). Dependence on a few key customers justifies a high severity rating.

risks.title: Risks related to supplier dependency and supply chain
risks.score_rationale: This risk is discussed across multiple paragraphs (pages 13-14) with terms such as 'rely on a limited number of companies', 'reduce control', 'failure to meet customer demands'. CPP's increased reliance on China exacerbates this risk.

risks.title: Volatility in raw material prices and inability to pass through costs
risks.score_rationale: This risk is clearly stated (page 14) with phrases like 'subject to price fluctuations', 'material adverse effect on Griffon's results of operations'. The inability to pass through cost increases is a key point.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks and tariffs on Chinese imports
risks.score_rationale: This risk is highly detailed (pages 14-15) and uses strong language ('risks associated with conducting a business that may be impacted by political and other developments', 'volatile nature of these tariff actions creates significant uncertainty'). CPP's growing dependence on China is an aggravating factor.

risks.title: Forced labor and regulatory compliance risks (China)
risks.score_rationale: This risk is introduced at the end of the China section (page 15) with reference to the UFLPA and increased inspections. The language ('potential to impact our business operations', 'detention costs accrue') indicates serious concern.

risks.title: Customer credit risk exposure
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned briefly but clearly (page 13): 'both HBP and CPP extend credit to its customers, which exposes Griffon to credit risk.' The mention of one customer representing a significant portion of receivables reinforces its importance.
